questionEn: By distilling water, distilled water is obtained. What is the conclusion about the composition of the source water?
questionUz: Suvni distillash orqali distillangan suv olinadi. Manba suvining tarkibi haqida qanday xulosa bor?
choicesEn: Water was a mixture that was physically separated
Distillation is only a chemical method
choicesUz: Suv jismoniy jihatdan ajratilgan aralashma edi
